title: Skip DTensor test_scaled_mm (failing on B200)
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #190097

Disables DistMatrixOpsTest.test_scaled_mm (and its generated
DistMatrixOpsTestWithLocalTensor variant), which fails on the B200 distributed
job with an "Invalid scaling configuration" error from the _scaled_mm meta on
the test's sub-row-wise sharded scales. Tracked/disabled via #190087 and
#190088; root cause under discussion in #190086.

Test Plan: test-only; the test is skipped.

Authored with Claude.
